enableCard.title: Batch & lot tracking
enableCard.description: Track stock as dated lots/batches with automatic oldest-first (FIFO) allocation on sales.
enableCard.body: Enabling this captures the product's current stock{variantSuffix} as an Opening batch, then all future stock changes go through batch receiving and adjustments. Aggregate stock is preserved.
enableCard.cannotDisable: Tracking cannot be turned off in this release, so enable it deliberately.

dialog.title: Enable batch tracking?
dialog.description: Current stock becomes an Opening batch. This can't be undone in this release.

enableCard.toastEnabled: Batch tracking enabled — opening stock captured.

adjustDialog.title: Adjust counted stock — {batchCode}
adjustDialog.description: Enter the counted quantity; the difference is logged.

receiveForm.title: Receive stock
receiveForm.needVariantFirst: Add at least one variant above before receiving stock — every batch belongs to a variant.
receiveForm.errorQuantityPositive: Quantity must be greater than zero.

expiryEditDialog.title: Correct expiry date — {batchCode}
expiryEditDialog.description: A batch with stock cannot be set to a past date.

enableExpiryCard.title: Expiry tracking
enableExpiryCard.description: Track a use-by date per batch and block selling expired stock.
enableExpiryCard.bullet1: Every current batch with stock needs an expiry date.
enableExpiryCard.bullet2: Expired batches can't be sold; a batch expiring today is sellable all day.
enableExpiryCard.bullet3: Expiry tracking cannot be disabled in this release.

dialog.title: Assign expiry dates
dialog.description: Set a date for each batch that currently has stock.
dialog.noneNeeded: No batches with stock — you can enable directly.

enableExpiryCard.errorAllDatesRequired: Give every batch an expiry date.

archiveDialog.title: Archive batch {batchCode}?
archiveDialog.description: Archiving retires this batch so it can no longer be sold or received. It does not change its stock — if you mean to write off {quantity} unit(s), adjust the batch to 0 first. This can't be undone.

disableTrackingCard.title: Disable batch tracking
disableTrackingCard.description: Turns this back into a simple product. Existing batches are archived (kept for history, no longer sellable), current total stock is preserved as a plain number, and you can edit stock directly again. You can re-enable tracking later (a new Opening batch is captured).

dialog.title: Disable batch tracking?
dialog.description: Existing batches will be archived and this product reverts to a simple product with its current total stock preserved. Tracking can be re-enabled later.

disableTrackingCard.toastDisabled: Batch tracking disabled — product is now a simple product.

manager.title: Batch inventory
manager.descriptionExpiry: Stock is tracked per batch. Sales allocate the earliest-expiring batch first automatically.
manager.descriptionFifo: Stock is tracked per batch. Sales allocate the oldest batch first automatically.
manager.reconciled: Aggregate stock reconciles with batch totals.
manager.noBatchesYet: No batches yet. Receive stock to create one.

actions.notEnabled: Batch tracking is not enabled for this store.
actions.expiryNotSupportedYet: Expiry tracking is not supported yet.
actions.reconciliationFailed: Could not enable tracking: stock reconciliation failed.
actions.chooseVariantToReceive: Choose a variant to receive into.
actions.variantNotFound: Variant not found for this product.
actions.quantityWholeNumber: Quantity must be a whole number for this product.
actions.expiryRequired: An expiry date is required for this product.
actions.expiryInPast: Expiry date cannot be in the past.
actions.batchArchivedCannotReceive: That batch is archived and cannot receive stock.
actions.batchCodeDifferentExpiry: That batch code already exists with a different expiry date.
actions.batchCodeRetry: That batch code was just created — please try again.
actions.productNoExpiryTracking: This product does not use expiry tracking.
actions.stockWholeNumber: Stock must be a whole number for this product.
actions.assignExpiryBeforeStock: Assign an expiry date to this batch before adding stock.
actions.conflictReload: The batch changed while you were editing — reload and try again.
actions.negativeStock: That adjustment would make aggregate stock negative.
actions.pastExpiryWithStock: A batch with stock cannot be given a past expiry date.
actions.reconciliationDriftBeforeDisable: Stock doesn't reconcile with batches — resolve the discrepancy before disabling.

refreshButton.label: Refresh expiry status
refreshButton.toastSummary: Expiry refreshed — {statuses} status change(s), {notifications} new alert(s).
